information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits an authoritative non-policy obligation charter. The final call consumes only that immediately preceding charter, receives no reopened common input, creates the lineage's first executable artifact, and emits one policy.

organization: two-call sequential lineage with full-context policy-free authority followed by source-blind sole policy materialization
